title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Moderna Phase 3 Cancer Vaccine Breakout: Moderna ($MRNA) stock skyrocketed over +110% following positive Phase 3 results showing its personalized mRNA melanoma cancer vaccine significantly reduces disease recurrence.

OpenAI Zero Data Retention Commitment: OpenAI reaffirmed Zero Data Retention for enterprise frontier models while previewing Private Safety Processing to enforce safety filters without server-side prompt logging.

Unitree Robotics $20B IPO Debut: Humanoid robotics maker Unitree Robotics debuted on public markets with a valuation exceeding $20 billion, triggering intense debate over humanoid commercialization timelines.
Terminal-Code VS Code CLI Launch: Developers unveiled terminal-code, bringing native VS Code extension compatibility and SSH integration directly into command-line terminal environments.
OpenCode Go Quota & Model Upgrades: OpenCode expanded usage limits for Muse Spark 1.2 and Hy3 models on OpenCode Go subscriptions, enabling sustained high-effort reasoning workflows.

items.title: @OpenAI: Zero Data Retention & Private Safety Processing
items.body: OpenAI reaffirmed its commitment to Zero Data Retention for enterprise frontier models while introducing Private Safety Processing, allowing real-time safety enforcement without server-side prompt logging.

items.title: @RobKnight__: Terminal-Code Brings VS Code to Terminal CLI
items.body: Developer Rob Pruzan released terminal-code, a CLI tool that runs VS Code environments natively inside terminal sessions over SSH with full extension compatibility and theme synchronization.

items.title: @thdxr: OpenCode Expands Muse Spark 1.2 & Hy3 Quotas
